name: @voqalize/demo-figurella-extension
description: Puts Javier, the figurella demo brain's guide, on figurella.cl: a Chrome extension that injects the call widget and the site adapter, fills the booking form as the visitor dictates it (she presses the button), and holds one call, in an offscreen document, across every Figurella tab and page load.
